# Harshit Sharmaa

> Six years building smart contracts, DeFi protocols, and ZK systems on projects holding over $1B in TVL. Lately: AI agents and infrastructure, where that world overlaps with web3. Founder, Blockchain World Co. Not a shill, just allergic to founders treating web3 like a cash machine.

Personal site and product index for Harshit Sharmaa — background, work history, and the side projects he's shipped outside client work. The site also embeds a small AI assistant (bottom-right "Ask me anything") that answers visitor questions about him in his own voice, grounded only in the facts listed here and on the site itself.

## Background

- Founder, Blockchain World Co (present) — public blockchain products, client work, community.
- Lead Blockchain Engineer, Meroku / Bitpack (2023–2024) — architecture, smart contract development and auditing.
- Full-stack Blockchain Developer, Swifty Global (2021–2023) — multi-chain wallet backend: DEX aggregator, EVM bridge, NFT marketplace.
- Blockchain Developer, RevInfotech (2021) — DEXs, staking/compounding protocols, arbitrage systems, consensus and network layers.
- Smart Contract Engineer, Shiba Inu (2021) — built ShibaSwap end to end; vote-escrowed staking, multi-chain farming, Shibarium cross-chain messaging.
- Blockchain Developer, Quillhash (2020) — token standards, ICOs, contract audits across five blockchains. Where he started.

Also into: cinema, philosophy, and longevity.

## Products

- [hardhat-airsign](https://harshitsharmaa.com/products/hardhat-airsign): Deploy smart contracts without ever putting a private key in .env. Official Hardhat community plugin, accepted onto Hardhat's own community plugins list.
- [ExDisplay](https://harshitsharmaa.com/products/exdisplay): Turn the tablet in your drawer into a second screen for your Mac.
- [Claude Usage Bar](https://harshitsharmaa.com/products/claude-usage-bar): Know your Claude limit before it knows you.
- [Yoinkr](https://harshitsharmaa.com/products/yoinkr): Yoink any YouTube video or audio — in seconds, for free.
- [Clippooor](https://harshitsharmaa.com/products/clippooor): Turn one long video into a week of Shorts and Reels, on autopilot. In development.
- [OnchainAura](https://harshitsharmaa.com/products/onchainaura): Discover your Aura Score, a read on your onchain journey. Live at onchainaura.fun.
- [Fortune Caster](https://harshitsharmaa.com/products/fortunecaster): A playful fortune cookie experience that lives inside Farcaster.
- [What Are the Odds](https://harshitsharmaa.com/products/what-are-the-odds): Dare your friends. Settle it on-chain.
- [Pether.AI](https://harshitsharmaa.com/products/pether-ai): A GPT-backed assistant that actually answers web3 questions.
- [Headshots.ai](https://harshitsharmaa.com/products/headshots-ai): Professional headshots, generated by AI.
